unsheeted.heard: Me Before We Get Into You"] You called

substitutions.sheet: Every hollow promise, every pride.
Like the joy of a bride on her wedding day,
Received by her Lord at the altar —
We behold You, Yehoshua — established we are.
At the table You prepared, we eat, we drink —
A new life everlasting begins here and now with You.
So I set my hands to what is mine,
Each ordinary morning, a preparation,
Builds on faithfulness and love.
We behold You, Yehoshua — established we are.
At the table You prepared, we eat, we drink —
In His holy name, Yehoshua ben El Shaddai,
Amen and Shalom.

arrangements.title: Established in Him
arrangements.label: Contemporary Christian
sheet: You call me forward into who You always knew I was.
My wandering heart finally found the name it was searching for.
I had tried every lesser thing,
Every hollow promise, every pride.
Then Your voice cut through the noise,
And something in me finally came alive.
This is not a feeling. This is not a fading song.
You have laid a foundation, and on it I belong.
Like the joy of a bride on her wedding day,
Received by her Lord at the altar —
Every heart overflowing, every voice raised high,
We behold You, Yehoshua — established we are.
At the table You prepared, we eat, we drink —
Your grace has made us more than we could ever be.
We are established in You.
Entering Your mansions, every homecoming promise fulfilled,
A new life everlasting begins here and now with You.
So I set my hands to what is mine,
The humble road now holy ground.
Each ordinary morning, a preparation,
Builds on faithfulness and love.
Make me faithful in the ordinary days,
Joyful in the dust and duty,
Worthy of the name I now carry.
Like the joy of a bride on her wedding day,
Received by her Lord at the altar —
Every heart overflowing, every voice raised high,
We behold You, Yehoshua — established we are.
At the table You prepared, we eat, we drink —
Your grace has made us more than we could ever be.
We are established in You.
Father, thank You for the heart of Your Son.
In His holy name, Yehoshua ben El Shaddai,
Amen and Shalom.
